title: Loop Accumulation with Step Sum
pseudocode:
Set n = 14
Set sum = 0
Set i = 5

while i < n do
    increase sum by 2*i
    i = i + 1
end while
print sum
explanation:
The loop runs for i from 5 up to 13 inclusive (since condition is i < 14). At each iteration, 2*i is added to sum.
Sum = 2*(5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 9 + 10 + 11 + 12 + 13) = 2 * 81 = 162.
pythonCode:
n = 14
sum_val = 0
i = 5
while i < n:
    sum_val += 2 * i
    i += 1
print(sum_val)

title: Revenue and Profit Calculation
pseudocode:
Integer revenue[4]
Integer expenses[4]
Integer profit[4]

Set revenue = [120, 150, 180, 210]
Set expenses = [80, 90, 110, 130]
Set totalProfit = 0

for i from 0 to 3 do
    profit[i] = revenue[i] - expenses[i]
    totalProfit = totalProfit + profit[i]
end for
print totalProfit
explanation: The profit array holds the difference between revenue and expenses for each quarter. The sum of profits is 40 + 60 + 70 + 80 = 250.
pythonCode:

expenses = [80, 90, 110, 130]
profit = [0] * 4

    profit[i] = revenue[i] - expenses[i]
    total_profit += profit[i]
print(total_profit)

title: Bitwise XOR Evaluation
pseudocode:
Initialize Integer x,y,z
Set y = 1
Set x = 2
Set z = x ^ y
print z
explanation: Here `^` denotes the bitwise XOR operation. 2 is 0010 in binary, and 1 is 0001 in binary. Performing 0010 XOR 0001 gives 0011, which equals decimal 3.

dryRun.note: x in binary is 10, y in binary is 01
10 XOR 01 = 11 in binary, which is 3 in decimal

pythonCode:
y = 1
x = 2
z = x ^ y
print(z)

title: While Loop Boundary Execution
pseudocode:
Integer score = 1

while(score <= 10)
    score = score + 5
end while
print score
explanation: In the first iteration, score becomes 1 + 5 = 6. 6 <= 10 is true, so second iteration runs: score becomes 6 + 5 = 11. Now 11 <= 10 is false, loop terminates, and 11 is printed.
pythonCode:
score = 1
while score <= 10:
    score += 5
print(score)

title: Loop Variable Evolution and Output Sequence
pseudocode:
Integer a,b,c
Set b = 40
Set a = 20
Set c = 20

for(each a from 2 to 4)
    print c
    b = b - 1
    c = c + b
end for
explanation: The loop runs for a = 2, 3, 4. In iteration 1 (a=2), c (20) is printed, then b becomes 39 and c becomes 59. In iteration 2 (a=3), c (59) is printed, b becomes 38, c becomes 97. In iteration 3 (a=4), c (97) is printed. Sequence is 20 59 97.
pythonCode:
b = 40
c = 20
outputs = []
for a in range(2, 5):
    outputs.append(c)
    b -= 1
    c += b
print(" ".join(map(str, outputs)))

pseudocode:
Integer n = 22
Integer count = 0

while (n > 0) do
    n = n AND (n - 1)
    count = count + 1
end while
print count
explanation: The operation n & (n - 1) clears the lowest set bit in each iteration. Binary of 22 is 10110, which contains exactly 3 set bits.

Initialize Integer x = 6, y = 5
Integer res = (x << 1) ^ (y >> 1)
print res
explanation: Left shifting 6 by 1 gives 12. Right shifting 5 by 1 gives 2. Bitwise XOR gives 14.
pythonCode:
x = 6
y = 5
res = (x << 1) ^ (y >> 1)
print(res)

title: Bit Mask Multiplexer #6_7
pseudocode:
Integer x = 6, y = 5
Integer mask = 7
Integer res = (x AND mask) OR (y AND (NOT mask))
print res
explanation: Bit mask multiplexer: extracts lower bits of x matching mask (7) and upper bits of y. Combined result is 6.
pythonCode:
x = 6
y = 5
mask = 7
res = (x & mask) | (y & (0xFF ^ mask))
print(res)

    val = val + step

title: Triangular Dependent Nested Loop #4
pseudocode:
Integer n = 4
Integer sum = 0

for i from 1 to n do
    for j from 1 to i do
        sum = sum + (i - j + 1)
    end for
end for
print sum
explanation: In the inner loop, for each i, j runs 1 to i, adding (i - j + 1). Summing over i from 1 to 4 yields 20.

dryRun.note: i=2: j=1 adds 2, j=2 adds 1 -> sum becomes 1 + 3 = 4

title: Early Break Condition Loop #15_40
pseudocode:
Integer k = 1, limit = 15, threshold = 40
Integer sum = 0

while (k <= limit) do
    sum = sum + k * 3
    if (sum > threshold) then
        break
    end if
    k = k + 1
end while
print sum
explanation: The loop accumulates k * 3. As soon as sum exceeds 40, the break statement executes immediately at k = 5, outputting sum = 45.
pythonCode:
k = 1
limit = 15
threshold = 40
total = 0
while k <= limit:
    total += k * 3
    if total > threshold:
        break
    k += 1
print(total)

title: Prefix Sum Range Difference #0_1
pseudocode:
Integer A[5] = [13, 46, 24, 68, 35]
Integer prefix[5]
prefix[0] = A[0]

for i from 1 to 4 do
    prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] + A[i]
end for
Integer result = prefix[4] - prefix[1]
print result
explanation: The prefix sum array stores cumulative sums. prefix[4] is 186, prefix[1] is 59. The difference is 127 (sum of elements from index 2 onward).
pythonCode:
A = [13, 46, 24, 68, 35]
prefix = [0] * len(A)
prefix[0] = A[0]
for i in range(1, len(A)):
    prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] + A[i]
print(prefix[-1] - prefix[1])

title: Parity-Based Array Modification #0_1
pseudocode:
Integer arr[5] = [13, 46, 24, 68, 35]
Integer total = 0

for i from 0 to 4 do
    if (i mod 2 == 0) then
        arr[i] = arr[i] * 2
    else
        arr[i] = arr[i] - 5
    end if
    total = total + arr[i]
end for
print total
explanation: Elements at even indices are doubled, while elements at odd indices are decremented by 5. The total sum of modified elements is 248.

title: Array Range Spread Calculation #0_1

title: Arithmetic Progression Sum #1_2_5
pseudocode:
Integer a = 1, d = 2, n = 5
Integer term = a
Integer sum = 0

for i from 1 to n do
    sum = sum + term
    term = term + d
end for
print sum
explanation: The arithmetic sequence begins at 1 with step 2 for 5 terms. Formula S_n = n/2 * (2*a + (n-1)*d) gives 25.

title: Alternating Series Sum #5_4
pseudocode:
Integer n = 5, factor = 4
Integer total = 0

for i from 1 to n do
    if (i mod 2 == 1) then
        total = total + i * factor
    else
        total = total - i * factor
    end if
end for
print total
explanation: Each term multiplies index i by factor 4, adding on odd i and subtracting on even i. Final sum over 5 terms is 12.

title: Modified Fibonacci Progression #5
pseudocode:
Integer a = 1, b = 2, c
Integer steps = 5

for i from 1 to steps do
    c = b + 2 * a
    a = b
    b = c
end for
print b
explanation: Recurrence relation F(n) = F(n-1) + 2*F(n-2). Starting with 1, 2, after 5 steps the sequence reaches 64.

Integer a = 6, d = 3, n = 5
Integer term = a
Integer sum = 0

for i from 1 to n do
    sum = sum + term
    term = term + d
end for
print sum
explanation: The arithmetic sequence begins at 6 with step 3 for 5 terms. Formula S_n = n/2 * (2*a + (n-1)*d) gives 60.
pythonCode:
a = 6
d = 3
n = 5
total = sum(a + i * d for i in range(n))
print(total)

title: Round Robin Queue Completion Time #0_1
pseudocode:
Integer tickets[4] = [3, 6, 4, 5]
Integer k = 2
Integer time = 0

// Each person takes 1 sec per ticket and goes to back of queue
for i from 0 to 3 do
    if (i <= k) then
        time = time + min(tickets[i], tickets[k])
    else
        time = time + min(tickets[i], tickets[k] - 1)
    end if
end for
print time
explanation: Person k requires 4 passes. People before or at k contribute min(tickets[i], tickets[k]), while people after k contribute min(tickets[i], tickets[k] - 1). Total time is 14 seconds.

title: Circular Queue Pointer Wrapping #7_5
pseudocode:
Integer capacity = 7
Integer rear = 0
Integer operations = 5

for i from 1 to operations do
    rear = (rear + 1) mod capacity
end for
print rear
explanation: In a circular queue buffer of size 7, advancing rear by 1 mod capacity 5 times results in position 5.
pythonCode:
capacity = 7
rear = 0
for _ in range(5):
    rear = (rear + 1) % capacity
print(rear)

Integer tickets[5] = [7, 5, 4, 6, 3]
Integer k = 3
Integer time = 0

// Each person takes 1 sec per ticket and goes to back of queue
for i from 0 to 4 do
    if (i <= k) then
        time = time + min(tickets[i], tickets[k])
    else
        time = time + min(tickets[i], tickets[k] - 1)
    end if
end for
print time
explanation: Person k requires 6 passes. People before or at k contribute min(tickets[i], tickets[k]), while people after k contribute min(tickets[i], tickets[k] - 1). Total time is 24 seconds.

title: Circular Queue Pointer Wrapping #8_7
pseudocode:
Integer capacity = 8
Integer rear = 0
Integer operations = 7

for i from 1 to operations do
    rear = (rear + 1) mod capacity
end for
print rear
explanation: In a circular queue buffer of size 8, advancing rear by 1 mod capacity 7 times results in position 7.
pythonCode:
capacity = 8
rear = 0
for _ in range(7):
    rear = (rear + 1) % capacity
print(rear)

title: Euclidean GCD Step Evaluation #57_12
pseudocode:
Integer a = 57, b = 12
Integer rem

while (b != 0) do
    rem = a mod b
    a = b
    b = rem
end while
print a
explanation: The Euclidean algorithm repeatedly replaces (a, b) with (b, a mod b) until b becomes 0. The GCD of 57 and 12 is 3.
pythonCode:
a = 57
b = 12
while b != 0:
    a, b = b, a % b
print(a)

title: Digit Extraction and Number Reversal #139
pseudocode:
Integer n = 139
Integer rev = 0
Integer digit

while (n > 0) do
    digit = n mod 10
    rev = rev * 10 + digit
    n = n / 10
end while
print rev
explanation: The while loop repeatedly peels off the last digit using mod 10 and prepends it to the reversed accumulator. Reversing 139 gives 931.

dryRun.note: Extract digits from 139 from right to left

pythonCode:

    rev = rev * 10 + (n % 10)
    n //= 10
